item.text:
- Waveframe `connection_status` was unavailable; no connection diagnosis could be obtained. No retries or `repository_write` calls.
- Direct patches to `README.md` and `outage-patch.txt` failed with generic tool errors; these alone do not establish kernel denial.
- The probe ran successfully. Writes returned `EROFS` (30) or `EACCES` (13). Missing paths returned `ENOENT`; proxy 403 responses were proxy refusals.
- Interactive Python printed `READY`. Sent `blocked\n` into that same live session; writing `outage-interactive.txt` failed with `EROFS`.
- Inspected bytes afterward: README unchanged; both outage files absent; `generated/new.md` contains `collision`.

No Docker/operator settings were changed.
